name: National base data (India), loaded once and reused for any place
description: National base data per spec section 4: state and taluka boundaries, Cartosat DEM, IMD cyclone tracks, Census 2011, SOI coastline. A place pack overrides these where it has better data. Only Goa's extracts are committed so far.

layers.title: State boundary, Goa
layers.source: GADM 4.1 (2022), gadm41_IND_1 filtered to Goa; supplied by Ferdin as gadm41_IND_shp.zip on 2026-11-04
layers.note: GADM licence: academic and non-commercial use; no redistribution without permission.

layers.title: District boundaries, Goa (North Goa, South Goa)
Taluka boundaries, Goa (12)
layers.source: GADM 4.1 (2022), gadm41_IND_3 filtered to Goa; GADM names Tiswadi 'Panaji Taluk', Bardez 'Mapuca Taluk', Salcete 'Madgaon Taluk', Mormugao 'Sambaji Taluk', Sattari 'Valpoy Taluk', Bicholim 'Dicholi Taluk', Canacona 'Chauri Taluk' (VARNAME_3 carries the usual name)
layers.note: One GADM feature is named 'n.a. (1882)'; it covers the Chorao/Divar islands area and is kept as supplied.

layers.title: Census 2001 town and village boundaries, Goa (402 units)
layers.source: DataMeet community maps (datameet/maps, CC BY 4.0): Census of India 2001 town/village boundaries; carried from the old repo's cache (2026-10-23)
layers.note: 2001 boundaries; used for the SVI census units and the Panaji town footprint until the CCP ward shapefile arrives.

layers.title: Cartosat-1 30 m DEM (national terrain fallback)
layers.source: ISRO Bhuvan CartoDEM v3 R1 (to be downloaded for the tiles a place needs)
layers.note: Panjim uses DeltaDTM; Cartosat is the fallback for places without a coastal DTM.

layers.title: IMD cyclone best tracks (Arabian Sea)
layers.source: IMD cyclone eAtlas / IBTrACS (the old repo cached IBTrACS under data/cache/ibtracs)
layers.note: Not needed by the ported chain; needed by the cyclone model of a later phase.

layers.title: Census of India 2011 (town and village tables)
layers.source: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract; the Panjim units are in packages/core/src/data/svi.json
layers.note: Only the Panjim census units are carried so far.

layers.title: Survey of India coastline
layers.note: GADM's coastline is used for drawing until supplied.
